name: How do I choose the right contractor for my room addition?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for my room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor is crucial for a successful room addition. Look for licensed, insured, and experienced general contractors specializing in additions. Check their portfolio for similar projects, read client testimonials, and verify their local reputation. Ask for a detailed proposal, clearly outlining the scope of work, timeline, and payment schedule. Communication and transparency are key throughout the selection process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured, and experienced contractor with a strong portfolio and positive client reviews. Ensure they provide a detailed proposal and maintain clear communication.
